description.value: Big Star Sandwich Co. is a Lower Mainland sandwich chain founded in 2013, now operating six locations across the region. The Burnaby shop on Canada Way specialises in hearty, made-to-order sandwiches built on a fresh rustic Filone roll with house slow-roasted beef, hand-pulled turkey, and other in-house cooked meats. Catering is available, and an online ordering option makes it a convenient refuelling stop on a longer ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Burnaby location at 3736 Canada Way with phone (604) 431-0373, both matching OSM. OSM tags diet:vegan=yes and diet:vegetarian=yes are plausible given the menu focus, though the website does not explicitly list vegan/vegetarian menu items by name. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears anywhere in the website content. OSM opening_hours (Mo-Su 10:00-20:00) conflict with the website's Burnaby hours (Mon-Fri 9AM-7PM, Sat-Sun 11AM-6PM).
concerns: OSM opening_hours (Mo-Su 10:00-20:00) conflict with the website's Burnaby-specific hours (Mon-Fri 9AM-7PM, Sat-Sun 11AM-6PM); OSM hours appear outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a legitimate, active sandwich shop useful as a food stop for touring cyclists, but none of the three required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify minimum WWC criteria before listing.
